SELECT g.store_id, s.name AS store_name, s.platform, g.parent_item_id, CASE WHEN g.variant_count = 1 THEN g.listing_id END AS listing_id, g.title, g.image_url, g.variant_count, g.mapped_count, g.min_price, g.max_price, g.currency FROM (SELECT l.store_id, l.parent_item_id, MIN(l.seller_sku) AS first_sku, COUNT(*) AS variant_count, SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mapped_count, MIN(l.title) AS title, MAX(l.image_url) AS image_url, MIN(l.price) AS min_price, MAX(l.price) AS max_price, MIN(l.currency) AS currency, MIN(l.id) AS listing_id FROM ecom_listing l
l.store_id = #{storeId}
AND (l.seller_sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.parent_item_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND NOT
GROUP BY l.store_id, l.parent_item_id, CASE WHEN l.parent_item_id IS NULL THEN l.id ELSE 0 END) g JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = g.store_id ORDER BY g.store_id, g.first_sku

SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec AS material_spec, m.unit, COALESCE(ls.cnt, 0) AS listing_count, COALESCE(bs.cnt, 0) AS bundle_count, COALESCE(st.cnt, 0) AS store_count FROM wms_material m LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.material_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ecom_listing l WHERE l.material_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.material_id) ls ON ls.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT b.material_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.listing_id) AS cnt FROM ecom_bundle_item b GROUP BY b.material_id) bs ON bs.material_id = m.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT u.material_id, COUNT(DISTINCT u.store_id) AS cnt FROM (SELECT l.material_id, l.store_id FROM ecom_listing l WHERE l.material_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT b.material_id, l.store_id FROM ecom_bundle_item b JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.id = b.listing_id) u GROUP BY u.material_id) st ON st.material_id = m.id WHERE m.is_template = 0
AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.spec LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND (ls.cnt IS NOT NULL OR bs.cnt IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY m.code
SELECT l.*, s.name AS store_name, s.platform FROM ecom_listing l JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = l.store_id WHERE l.material_id = #{materialId} ORDER BY l.store_id, l.seller_sku

SELECT l.id, l.store_id, l.seller_sku, l.platform_item_id, l.parent_item_id, l.title, l.variant, l.price, l.currency, l.fulfillment, l.status, l.compose_type, l.fnsku, b.qty AS pack_qty, s.name AS store_name, s.platform FROM ecom_bundle_item b JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.id = b.listing_id JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = l.store_id WHERE b.material_id = #{materialId} ORDER BY l.store_id, l.seller_sku
SELECT m.id AS "id", m.code AS "code", m.name AS "name", m.spec AS "spec" FROM wms_material m WHERE m.code IN #{c} AND m.is_template = 0 AND m.status = 1
